issues.desc: CHK-001 lacks an explicit user-observable completion outcome and negative control. PLAN acceptance should state that a contradictory PASS envelope (for example unverified plus verifiedBy, nonzero missing/failed counts, or conflicting semantic fields) is rejected with a stable actionable reason before evidence persistence, while a complete internally consistent PASS and legitimate non-PASS envelope still follow their existing paths without false rejection.

CHK-002 describes the AST/taint mechanism but not the product-level proof of noninterference and boundedness. PLAN acceptance should require that a production invocation cannot turn SMOKE/TEST control data into write/rm/rename/exec/spawn side effects, and that ordinary production environment reads plus explicitly capability-limited temp-repository test helpers remain accepted, so completion is recognizable without widening the guard into a general env/sink ban.

PLAN must enumerate the exact PASS-envelope consumers/fields and the bounded production directories, sink set, and permitted capability-limited exemptions. As written, “gate-relevant envelopes” plus all core/handlers write/rm/rename/exec/spawn flows could expand this compact regression story into a framework-wide refactor, even though the two checklist items themselves are distinct and no duplicate active story was found.
